name: Nee~ Onii-chaa~n ~Imouto-tachi no Dokkidoki Yuuwaku Kassen!~
original_name: ねぇ～お兄ちゃぁ～ん ～妹たちのドッキドキ誘惑合戦！～
source:
Naoki has two younger sisters, Yura and Riru. One day, Yura suddenly makes sexual approaches to him! Riru aggressively approaches him as well! A battle for Naoki breaks out like this! Well, which girl will he choose...?
